trust.title: Trusted for marketplaces sellers rely on

problem.heading: Selling online is harder than it looks.
problem.intro: Most sellers lose time and revenue because marketplace management is complex, repetitive, and easy to get wrong.

complexity.title: Technical Complexity
complexity.description: Every platform has different rules for images, titles, metadata, and SEO.

time.title: Time-Consuming Workflows
time.description: Photography, descriptions, uploads — it all adds up to hours you don't have.

performance.title: Poor Listing Performance
performance.description: Unoptimized listings miss search traffic and fail to convert browsers into buyers.

scaling.title: Scaling Challenges
scaling.description: More products means more chaos — without a system, growth becomes painful.

solution.heading: One partner. The entire pipeline.
solution.intro: FLOW combines AI-assisted workflows with human expertise to manage everything from product photography to marketplace publishing. You hand us the product — we handle the rest.

workflow.heading: Your product. Our process. Marketplace success.
workflow.intro: A structured, repeatable workflow designed to get your products live faster and performing better.

s1.title: Submit Your Products
s1.description: Share your product details, images, or inventory list with us.

s2.title: Content Creation
s2.description: We photograph, write, and structure your listings professionally.

s3.title: Listing Optimization
s3.description: We optimize titles, keywords, and structure for each platform.

s4.title: Marketplace Publishing
s4.description: We upload and publish listings directly to your seller accounts.

s5.title: Account Management
s5.description: We monitor performance and manage updates on your behalf.

s6.title: Sales Growth
s6.description: Optimized listings drive more visibility, clicks, and conversions.

packageBuilder.heading: Build your own package.
packageBuilder.intro: Not every catalogue fits a ready-made plan. Take only the parts you need — content, account management, or both — and watch your monthly price build as you go.
packageBuilder.productsHint: How many products we produce content for each month. More than 500? Talk to us.
packageBuilder.contentHint: Priced per product, included in your monthly plan.

needsHint.photography: Studio photos on white, 3–5 per product
needsHint.listing: Bilingual SEO titles, bullets and descriptions

packageBuilder.modulesHint: Pick only the parts you want us running. The base fee covers account access, a dedicated contact, your monthly report and account setup — no setup fee.

modulesDesc.uploading: New products listed and existing ones kept current
modulesDesc.returns: We handle returns and customer claims
modulesDesc.purchase-orders: We raise and track PO's for you

packageBuilder.allMonthly: One monthly figure. No setup fee, nothing billed separately.

pricingTeaser.heading: Pick a plan, or build your own.
pricingTeaser.intro: Per-item content from 10 EGP, or an all-in monthly plan from 3,500 EGP. Need something in between? Choose your own features and price it yourself.

cookies.title: We use cookies
cookies.body: We keep an anonymous record of how the site is used so we can improve it, and so our team has context if you get in touch. No tracking happens until you accept.

faqAside.title: Still have questions?
faqAside.intro: Send us a note and a human will reply, usually the same day.

finalCta.heading: Ready to put your products to work?
finalCta.intro: Tell us what you sell. We'll come back with a plan, a price, and a timeline.
